verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an AI app builder with hosted databases and publishing, but the evidence never documents a sandbox or staging environment, or any separation of test data from production data. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit. Plan Mode avoids code changes, which is a dry-run, not sandbox isolation. GitHub branches and private publishing are different features. The AI's control over its environment (bolt-gh-2) says nothing about isolating production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
